learning_outcomes.text: Expand their vocabulary, especially in the IT area.
Improve their writing and speaking skills through appropriate simulation and the situation-specific application of the English language.
Deepen their knowledge of English grammar.
Improve their communication skills and language intuition by discussing selected technical topics.
Independently comprehend the content of English technical texts.
Use English technical journals and books within the scope of research and programming projects.

syllabus_topics: Selected IT topics such as computer users, computer architecture, computer applications, operating systems, multimedia, networks, the World Wide Web, webpage creator, communication systems, computing support, data security, software engineering, people in computing, the future of IT, electronic publishing
Presentation topics from the current English-language press
Exercises on grammar, semantics, listening comprehension, text presentation, introduction to business correspondence
Use of textbooks for self-study and further education
Dealing with technical articles and scientific publications
Use of online resources, such as stackoverflow (https://stackoverflow.com/) in programming projects
Use of online forums for questions and contributions in English
bibliography: GLENDINNING, Eric H. und John MACEWAN, . Oxford English for information technology. Oxford [u.a.]: Oxford Univ. Press.
